title: Bride and Groom Wedding Portrait, 1950s Black & White Snapshot Photo
description: A candid black-and-white snapshot capturing a smiling newlywed couple on their wedding day, dated June 24, 1950. The bride wears a satin dress with a veil, and the groom wears a tuxedo with a white bow tie while holding a cigarette outside the venue entrance. The print has classic scalloped deckle edges typical of 1950s photo developing.
